# Task: choose A, f and phi, write your prediction, then plot to verify
# Requirements: change the frequency at least once and the phase at least once, and tell the two curves apart with a legend
# Success criteria: two curves; legend, title, both axis labels; you can say which curve shows the frequency change and which shows the phase change
# The base time axis t is ready from the Seed's setup_exercise; use t directly

# A_ex = ...

# x_ex = ...
# plt.plot(...)
# plt.legend()
# plt.show()

clips.caption: Choose your own A, f and phi, <emphasis level="strong">predict</emphasis> the waveform, then verify it in code. Change the <emphasis level="strong">frequency</emphasis> at least once and the <emphasis level="strong">phase</emphasis> at least once, and use a legend.

Success criteria: a title and both axis labels; you can point out which curve shows the <emphasis level="strong">frequency</emphasis> change and which the <emphasis level="strong">phase</emphasis> change. Run it, look, then continue.
